c74object.name: evi.lorez~
c74object.digest: A novel two-pole nonlinear Ladder filter
c74object.description:
evi.lorez~ is a 'max define' for the evi_lorez.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.lorez~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does.
Nonlinear 12dB TPT Lowpass with excellent modulation properties and allpass alignment. Capable of all audio rate modulation with cutoff FM-able whilst remaining stable. Resonance stays strong even in lower frequencies. The abstraction includes code which can be extracted for parameter rate control of the coefficients calculation and linear operation if required.

inlet.description: Self oscillates at resonance==1 but can take higher resonance with a little loss in anti-aliasing.

attribute.name: oversample
attribute.description: 2x oversampling if on (default), 1x if off (careful). Oversampling almost doubles the CPU usage.

c74object.discussion: For more information about other nonlinear Ladder filters in evieve, see the 'evieve ladder' tab of the helpfile.
